title: Frontier
hook: Follow a stranger across an Earth that feels like the edge of the map.
copy: A climate-ravaged Earth, a dangerous journey and a love story that survives the crossing. Start here for a western’s momentum and the intimacy of a queer romance.
reason: A western built around movement, danger and connection on an unfamiliar Earth.

title: Floating Hotel
hook: Check in for a mystery. Stay for the people who keep the place running.
copy: An ageing hotel travels from planet to planet. Its staff, guests and secrets make this an ensemble story about the places and people we call home.
themes: Found family · Ensemble cast · Locked-room mystery
reason: A warm ensemble mystery centred on a place people make into a home.

title: Idolfire
mood: A pilgrimage with a little romance
hook: Take the long road to a city where old gods still have a claim.
copy: Two women travel towards the ruins of an empire. Start here for a slow-burn sapphic romance that develops over the course of a long, dangerous journey.
reason: A travelling party, the remains of an empire and a romance that has time to unfold.

title: Heaven’s Graveyard
hook: Dig for a legend and find a past that refuses to stay buried.
copy: An archaeologist follows the traces of a figure others dismiss as myth. The discovery of a buried city brings old magic, political pressure and questions about whom history remembers.
themes: Archaeology · Buried magic · Myth and memory
reason: An excavation drives a sapphic fantasy mystery about evidence, memory and buried magic.
